copy.title: The Docket
copy.tagline: Protect a child's childhood before the system devours it.
howTo: Use the arrow keys (or swipe) to collect every bit of childhood in the docket.
Grab a Reform (the big markers) to turn the tables — then push the system back.
Clear a maze and the next assignment is larger: faster mechanisms, higher stakes.
Ten stages. The moral-injury meter climbs with every one you clear. (Phase 3.)
endLines: You can clear every maze and the system still grinds on.
Protecting one child at a time can't fix a rigged docket.
Reform is the only real win.
copy.shareText: I tried to protect a child's childhood from the docket in The Docket. The system is the real boss. Beat my score.

ending.beatWon: You cleared all ten assignments. The Docket kept right on grinding.
ending.beatLost: The Docket caught you. It was never winnable one child at a time.
body: The toll has a name: moral injury — being made to do harm by a system you can't fix from inside it.
No score erases it. The maze was rigged, not just hard.
There's only one real win — change the system itself:
ending.reformHeading: The only real win: reform the docket

reformPlan.title: Name the corruption
reformPlan.detail: Make eliminating family-court corruption the priority it deserves to be.

reformPlan.title: Pass the CHILD Protection Act of 2027
reformPlan.detail: Corruption Hiding Inside Legal Dockets — a bill aimed at the rigged docket itself.

reformPlan.title: Tie the money to compliance
reformPlan.detail: Link Title IV-D federal grant funds to state family-court compliance.

reformPlan.title: Put federal oversight on the dockets
reformPlan.detail: Use that federal lever to hold state family courts accountable.

reformPlan.title: Term-limit Congress
reformPlan.detail: Term limits for the U.S. House and Senate, applied with a grandfather clause.

reformPlan.title: Shrink the federal government
reformPlan.detail: A hiring freeze and early-retirement packages for federal employees.

reformPlan.title: Lower taxes by cutting waste
reformPlan.detail: Reduce fraud, waste, and headcount — not services — to lower taxes.

reformPlan.title: Put children first
reformPlan.detail: Every step ties back to one throughline: putting Missouri's children first.

reformPlan.title: Don't just talk — act
reformPlan.detail: Reform comes from action, not noise.

reformPlan.title: Your move
reformPlan.detail: Read the four priorities and join the effort.
